title: Naming the Living Decision-to-Documentation Artifact
summary: Accepted naming decision for the artifact that moves from exploration through decisions and live implementation tracking into permanent documentation. The stable product noun remains Dossier, 'living dossier' is explanatory copy, and Living Dossier remains the runner-up. Implementation tracking stays open until every consequence card is terminal.
statusReason: Every consequence card is now terminal: AGT-2539, AGT-2580, AGT-2537, AOW-13, and WEB-18 are all archived and delivered. The naming decision and its implementation tracking are both closed, so this Dossier moves to documented.
